scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:build:android: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug --no-problems-report
scripts.check: node --check src/app.js && node --check scripts/local-server.mjs && node --check scripts/mail-diagnostics.mjs && node --check scripts/gmail-diagnostics.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs
